title: Mona lisa, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Amalgamation of arts grasped in a silver coin Decorative frame covered with fine gold Continuation of the unique numismatic series Perfect gift for art connoisseurs The perfect, world-famous portrait of Mona Lisa secured Leonardo da Vinci a safe place in the history of art. For centuries, the image of the lady has been an unsolvable puzzle and served as an ideal of beauty and femininity. The coin, with the miniature reproduction of the painting, perfectly reflects the original character of the masterpiece and will inevitably become a unique item among your home collection.
